cohort: The study included 72 women who underwent laparoscopic hysterectomy and salpingectomy/salpingo-oophorectomy between May 2022 and July 2023.
finding: No statistically significant difference was observed in surgical parameters, including total surgery duration, hemoglobin decrease, complications, or hospital stay, between patients undergoing laparoscopic hysterectomy using either a 55-inch or a 27-inch 4 K-HD monitor.
